note: Focused failure before the exclusion. The design writes a = 1 and then waits on @(a ^ b); Icarus 13.0 wakes the process at that time, Verilator 5.052 does not. IEEE 1800-2023 9.4.2 synchronizes the statement with a value change of the expression, and the change of a happened before the event control executed. A standalone probe also wakes in Icarus, and a new event expression reports an event at time 0 there.
